sans.$value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
sans.$description: Frozen decision (v12): SF native first, Geist fallback. -apple-system/BlinkMacSystemFont resolve to San Francisco on Apple platforms (the native look); var(--font-geist-sans) is the cross-platform fallback set on <html> by Next.js app/layout.tsx via the geist package — must be preserved verbatim.

mono.$value: var(--font-geist-mono), "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, monospace
mono.$description: var(--font-geist-mono) is a runtime CSS var set on <html> by Next.js app/layout.tsx via the geist package — must be preserved verbatim
